page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-32-lssd is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 248 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor operating at 2.3 GHz, the system features 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The architecture is x86_64, supported by a large 504 MB L3 cache. This instance includes integrated local storage consisting of five NVMe SSDs totaling 1745 GB, providing high-speed local data access without requiring external block storage for primary workloads.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong performance across memory and compute-intensive tasks. The instance achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 2307.0 and a multi-core score of 18257.0, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 53228.41. In memory bandwidth testing, it registers a read-only cached small-block speed of 2702.38 GB/sec and an uncached large-block read speed of 168.46 GB/sec. Single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression show top-tier performance at 36.83 GB/sec and 15.57 GB/sec respectively. For database operations, the server handles 17024.29 PassMark database operations and 62.26 million Redis SET operations per second. It also supports LLM inference, processing 195.69 tokens/sec for prompt processing on a medium 7B model.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c4-highmem-32-lssd offers a balanced resource density, combining high memory capacity per core with fast local NVMe SSD storage. This configuration reduces the need to provision separate high-performance storage volumes, optimizing the overall infrastructure spend for data-heavy applications. The instance is highly suited for memory-intensive databases, real-time analytics, large-scale software compilation, and local caching layers. It is also well-suited for medium-scale language model inference and high-throughput web serving.
